summary: Anonymous device "01a1a860-e410-7e96-ae38-b43568f6cf1f": 2 events in 90 days, 1 recorded sessions.
sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1786050468685
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826528685
)
SELECT event, ts_ms, path, session_id, props FROM ev WHERE pid = '01a1a860-e410-7e96-ae38-b43568f6cf1f' OR distinct_id = '01a1a860-e410-7e96-ae38-b43568f6cf1f'
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 100
